snippet.title: Manhunt Underway After Father of Six Fatally Stabbed Outside Melbourne Nightclub | 10 News First
snippet.description:

Dozens of shocked partygoers witnessed the attack - that police suspect was targeted - following a wild brawl on busy Chapel Street.
